candidates.title: Trump takes suit against Hillary Clinton over 2016 election to Supreme Court
candidates.excerpt: Trump's lawyers wrote in the appeal that Supreme Court review of the case is needed in order to protect the Presidency.

candidates.title: Congress to hold 'major stir' on Oct 12 as anti-SIR protests escalate
Employees’ Union-led alliance takes early lead in TGSRTC recognised union elections
candidates.excerpt: The Employees' Union-led alliance has emerged ahead in the Telangana State Road Transport Corporation recognised union elections, according to preliminary trends, with a strong showing in the Greater Hyderabad region. The polls, held after nearly a decade, witnessed a 98 per cent voter turnout.

candidates.title: Farmers Felicitate Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu for Providing Water Security Through Pattiseema Lift Irrigation Project
candidates.excerpt: The farmers and irrigation association representatives, accompanied by Minister Nimmala Ramanaidu, visited the Secretariat, felicitated the Chief Minister and conveyed their special thanks to him.

candidates.title: "Even Tweet Written By US": Iran MP Mocks Pakistan's Mediation Efforts
candidates.excerpt: Iranian parliament member Mohsen Zanganeh took a dig at Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, possibly over one of his statements on X, dated April 8.

candidates.title: Alur MLA Released From Kurnool Jail After 69 Days
candidates.excerpt: Supporters gathered near the Kurnool court on Saturday after the release of the MLA and the other accused.

candidates.title: Pinapaka BRS unit calls for phased stir against sand mafia in agency areas
candidates.excerpt: Former Pinapaka MLA Rega Kantha Rao alleged large-scale illegal sand mining in agency areas of the district and accused the state government of diverting mining-related funds meant for local development. Announcing a phased agitation under the BRS banner, he said protests, road blockades and a siege of the Collectorate would be organised between October 12 and November 5.

candidates.title: 'Suspicion Is Not Proof': 124 Ex-Bureaucrats Defend Election Commission
candidates.excerpt: The letter, addressed to the citizens of India, comes amid protests by Opposition leaders who allege irregularities in electoral rolls and claims of "vote chori", or theft of votes.

candidates.title: Social Security $90 checks: Why Trump is sending extra money to millions of seniors
candidates.excerpt: The administration's payment announcements come against a backdrop of voter concerns about affordability and the president's handling of the economy.

candidates.title: Double taxi fares, traffic jams trouble Delhi commuters amid protest curbs
candidates.excerpt: Travel restrictions across Delhi and the National Capital Region triggered traffic jams, disrupted public transport and pushed taxi fares higher on Saturday. Commuters reported long walks, difficulty reaching railway stations and delays, while police detained three CJP leaders heading to protest

candidates.title: After Citing "Other Sorrows", Sonam Wangchuk's Hunger Strike Warning Over CJP Protest Crackdown
candidates.excerpt: "I will be compelled to consider an Anshan Fast (hunger strike) or Padyatra March (foot march) if they are not released by tomorrow," Sonam Wangchuk said,as the CJP and Opposition leaders were disallowed from protesting at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi.

candidates.title: KTR demands action against Gajwel MRO over alleged remarks to farmer
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao demanded action against the Gajwel MRO over alleged remarks to a distressed farmer seeking help to save his agricultural land. The incident has triggered criticism of the Congress government over its treatment of farmers
